Four open PRs already target that change (#9246, #9264, #9267, #9316 are all open and unmerged per GITHUB FACTS), so B would widen scope and risk merge conflicts. Option C would make this issue depend on #9246, which is still unmerged. It would also ask the pipeline to close an issue, which the pipeline cannot do. The two-line test fix is small, separate and reversible, so it should ship now.
